content.text:
The contact page form had lost the spacing between its fields. In `site/css/components.css`, `.form-field` had `margin-bottom: 0`, so the fields were stacked tight against each other. I changed it to `var(--space-4)` (16px).

I picked 16px because the missing height matched it. The phone screenshot was 80px shorter than the approved one, which is five gaps of 16px. All 12 visual tests now pass, including both contact screenshots at desktop and phone size. I didn't run the functional tests, since this was a CSS-only change.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
